resolution: BENCHHINT-0606 fixed forward inside the CUTOUTFLIP commit 12d36473c. Root cause: depthHintGrid indexed per-PART grids with a SEGMENT paint target (e.g. lUpperArm), hitting undefined.slice() and killing <BenchTarget> behind GlobalErrorBoundary. PaintBench now resolves the owning part via paintTargetPart() before grid lookup, and depthHintGrid gained boundary hardening (foreign id -> flat hint, rides the FOOTMESH wave in paintKit.ts). Verified alive headlessly on the formerly-crashing target; proof shot /tmp/benchfix-fixed.png.
